name: ExtensionOfTimeClaimBuilder
tagline: Never miss a time bar: delay events, notices, EOT claims and entitlement in one Power Apps app.
description: A complete extension-of-time claims app for contractors: log delay events the day you become aware of them, track notice, detailed-claim and assessor-response time bars for FIDIC 2017, NEC4, AIA A201, JCT or your own contract, assess the entitlement (critical delay after float, risk owner, concurrency, compensable days), build the evidence pack, score claim strength, move claims through submission, assessment, determination and dispute on a board, and see the effect on the completion date and LD exposure. Draft notices, claim summaries and monthly register reports come out as text for e-mail and flows.
features: Contract-form time bars with overrides and warning window
Notice, detailed claim and assessor response clocks
Late-notice explanation and time-bar risk flags
Indicative entitlement: critical delay, float, risk owner, concurrency, compensable days, time-related cost, LD relief
Status rules for notice, submission, assessment, grant, part grant, rejection, dispute and close-out
Completion date projection and LD exposure
Draft notice, claim summary, chase reminder and register summary texts
Drag & drop claim board, search, filters, grouping, bulk actions, CSV export, undo
Demo mode with 30 fictional delay events
Desktop, tablet and phone layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
controlType: standard (React 16.14.0 bundled; two controls: ExtensionOfTimeClaimBuilder data-set + ExtensionOfTimeClaimBuilderPortal field control for Power Pages)
